_comment: Vehicle Atlas Cell Registry — Phase 0 stub. Schema per architecture/asset-standards/3d-model-standards.md.

_atlas_format.uv_formula: For cell at (row R, col C): U in [C/4, (C+1)/4], V in [R/4, (R+1)/4]
_atlas_format.v_axis_convention: OpenGL (V origin at bottom-left). Artists using Blender must apply V_opengl = 1 - V_blender before mapping to atlas cells. All vehicle UVs must be authored in OpenGL convention or check #10 will fail for all 5 V1 vehicle assets.
